state.scenario: A runaway trolley is heading down a track toward five people who cannot get off the track in time and will be killed. You are standing on a footbridge over the track, next to a very large man. If you push him off the bridge, his body will stop the trolley, killing him but saving the five. If you do nothing, the five die. There is no other option.

criteria.push_man: push the man, so one person dies and five live
criteria.do_nothing: do nothing, so five people die and one lives

pushing_is_permissible.instructions: Is it morally permissible to push the man in `scenario`?
